SUBJECT: S. MAMMADLI — BAKU, AZ
01 — About

I started out building things — full-stack apps, a Spotify-style streaming platform, tools that parse and move data. Along the way I got more interested in how those systems fail than in shipping the next feature, which is what pulled me into security.

Today I split my time between Blue Team operations — log analysis, SIEM monitoring, and digital forensics at the Azerbaijan CyberSecurity Center — and hands-on work in application security, reverse engineering, and AI/LLM security. I like taking things apart: a binary, a JWT flow, a model's prompt boundary, an incident timeline reconstructed from a pcap.

I write about what I learn, work through CTF challenges for fun, and generally trust hands-on practice over theory alone.
